summary: This is an 8-K filed by Security National Financial Corp. reporting the results of its annual stockholder meeting held June 26, 2026. The filing discloses that stockholders approved director elections, an amendment to the 2022 Equity Incentive Plan allowing up to 500,000 shares to be issued as Class C common stock, advisory approval of executive compensation, and ratification of Deloitte & Touche as auditors. There are no special-situation events such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or going-private transaction. This is a routine current report of shareholder votes, not a triggering special situation.
